pois.name: Narikala Fortress
pois.address: Narikala Hill, Old Tbilisi, 0105 Tbilisi, Georgia
pois.description: Ancient 4th-century fortress overlooking Old Tbilisi and the Mtkvari River with sweeping panoramic views.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic panoramic views over Old Tbilisi and Mtatsminda
✓ Ancient 4th-century citadel accessible by scenic aerial cable car
pois.tip: Ride the aerial cable car up from Rike Park and walk down through the historic botanical garden trail.

provenance.price_source: Free Citadel Access (Cable car fare ~2.5 GEL)

pois.name: Holy Trinity Cathedral of Tbilisi (Sameba)
pois.description: The main Georgian Orthodox cathedral, one of the largest religious buildings in the South Caucasus.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Majestic Georgian Orthodox architecture on Elia Hill
✓ Peaceful landscaped grounds with sweeping city vistas
pois.tip: Modest attire required: head coverings for women and long trousers for men are provided at the entrance.

pois.name: Bridge of Peace & Rike Park
pois.description: Modern bow-shaped pedestrian bridge of glass and steel connecting Old Tbilisi with Rike Park over the Mtkvari River.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Striking pedestrian bridge with illuminated LED canopy
✓ Direct connector to the Rike Park aerial cable car
pois.tip: Visit at dusk when thousands of LED lights illuminate the river reflection.

pois.name: Abanotubani Sulfur Baths & Legvtakhevi Waterfall
pois.address: Abano St, Old Tbilisi, 0105 Tbilisi, Georgia
pois.description: Historic brick dome bathhouses built on natural hot sulfur springs where Tbilisi was originally founded, leading to a hidden canyon waterfall.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ The historic heart and namesake of Tbilisi ('warm location')
✓ Picturesque brick domes and canyon walkway to natural waterfall
pois.tip: Stroll the wooden walkway past the domes into Legvtakhevi gorge to see the 22-meter waterfall in the city center.

provenance.place_verification: Old Tbilisi Historic District Preservation Registry
provenance.price_source: Gorge Walkway Free / Bathhouses private booking (50-150 GEL/hr)
provenance.opening_hours_source: Walkway open daily; baths 08:00 AM - 11:00 PM

pois.name: Georgian National Museum & Rustaveli Avenue
pois.description: Houses the world-famous Colchian Archaeological Treasury of pre-Christian gold artifacts and exhibitions on Caucasian history.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World-class archaeological gold treasury from ancient Colchis
✓ Premier cultural institution on Tbilisi's grandest boulevard
pois.tip: Closed on Mondays. Audio guides are available in English at the front desk.

provenance.price_source: Official Entry Ticket (30 GEL standard adult)

pois.name: Mtatsminda Park & Funicular
pois.description: Mount Mtatsminda plateau reached by the historic 1905 funicular railway, offering the highest panoramic viewpoint in Tbilisi.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Unmatched bird's-eye panorama across the entire Mtkvari River valley
✓ Historic cliffside funicular railway experience
pois.tip: Have tea or fresh Georgian lagidze water at the historic Funicular Restaurant terrace.

provenance.price_source: Funicular Rail Transit (10 GEL per direction)

pois.name: Chronicles of Georgia
pois.address: Tbilisi Sea Heights, Temka, Tbilisi, Georgia
pois.description: Monumental stone complex sculpted by Zurab Tsereteli depicting 3,000 years of Georgian royalty and biblical history overlooking the Tbilisi Sea.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Often called 'Georgia's Stonehenge' — towering 30-meter black stone pillars
✓ Uncrowded monument overlooking the peaceful Tbilisi Sea reservoir
pois.tip: Combine with a scenic drive past the Tbilisi Sea shoreline. Best photographed in late afternoon sun.

pois.name: Rezo Gabriadze Marionette Theater & Clock Tower
pois.address: 13 Shavteli St, Old Tbilisi, 0105 Tbilisi, Georgia
pois.description: Whimsical leaning fairytale clock tower and world-famous marionette theater built by master artist Rezo Gabriadze.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Fairytale leaning clock tower with mechanical puppet show on the hour
✓ Located in a tranquil pedestrian square near Anchiskhati Basilica
pois.tip: Catch the angel mechanical puppet striking the bell at 12:00 PM or 07:00 PM.

provenance.price_source: Clock tower exterior free / Theater tickets separate

pois.name: Dry Bridge Flea Market
pois.address: Dry Bridge, Saarbruecken Bridge, Tbilisi, Georgia
pois.description: Vibrant open-air antique and art bazaar featuring Soviet memorabilia, handmade Georgian jewelry, vintage cameras, and local paintings.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Legendary open-air cultural bazaar with eclectic vintage artifacts
✓ Walkable riverbank setting near Dedaena Park
pois.tip: Weekends feature the largest collection of artists and vendors. Polite bargaining is customary.

pois.name: Sioni Cathedral & Old Town Heritage Quarter
pois.address: 3 Sioni St, Old Tbilisi, 0105 Tbilisi, Georgia
pois.description: Historic 6th-century cathedral in the heart of Old Tbilisi housing the sacred Grapevine Cross of St. Nino.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Spiritual center of historical Georgia with 19th-century frescoes
✓ Surrounded by atmospheric carved-wood balcony alleyways and artisan tea shops
pois.tip: Explore the adjacent cobblestone lanes of Chardin and Sioni streets for authentic local handicrafts.

pois.name: Shavi Lomi
pois.address: 28 Zurab Kvlividze St, Chugureti, 0102 Tbilisi, Georgia
pois.signature_dish: Georgian Cheese and Walnut Pkhali Board with Fresh Hot Mchadi Cornbread
pois.vegetarian_dish: Pkhali Assortment (Spinach, Beetroot & Walnut), Fried Sulguni & Spiced Lobio
pois.description: Iconic vintage courtyard restaurant celebrated for inventive reinterpretations of traditional Georgian regional classics and extensive vegetarian pkhali boards.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Acclaimed Georgian culinary landmark celebrated for authentic vegetarian dishes
✓ Charming leafy bohemian courtyard in historic Chugureti
pois.tip: Order the Gobi platter — a large wooden bowl of mixed vegetable walnut pkhali, cheeses, and warm cornbread.

pois.name: Barbarestan
pois.signature_dish: 19th-Century Herb Lobio, Mushroom Stew with Wild Mountain Greens & Puri Bread
pois.vegetarian_dish: Duchess Barbaré's Herb-Braised Beans, Foraged Mushroom Pot & Pumpkin Pastry
pois.description: Celebrated fine-dining restaurant based entirely on the 19th-century historic recipes of Georgian Duchess Barbaré Jorjadze.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World-renowned restaurant recreating 19th-century royal Georgian recipes
✓ Exceptional vegetarian dishes prepared with heirloom herbs and mountain ingredients
pois.tip: Advance evening dinner reservation is highly recommended.

pois.name: Salobie Bia
pois.signature_dish: Clay-Pot Traditional Lobio with Jonjoli Pickles and Mchadi
pois.vegetarian_dish: Authentic Spiced Red Kidney Bean Stew (Lobio), Marinated Vegetables & Corn Cakes
pois.description: Intimate artist-bistro renowned for perfecting Georgia's staple comfort dish: aromatic slow-simmered kidney beans in clay pots with pickled jonjoli.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Master of traditional clay-pot vegetarian Lobio and fresh cornbread
✓ Art-filled salon curated by Georgian painter Giorgi Ioseliani
pois.tip: The Shkmeruli and Lobio pots served bubbling hot with crispy pickles are the signature items.

pois.name: Culinarium Khasheria
pois.address: 23 Abano St, Old Tbilisi, 0105 Tbilisi, Georgia
pois.signature_dish: Fresh Herb Beetroot Carpaccio, Local Sulguni Salad & Wild Herb Broth
pois.vegetarian_dish: Mushroom Khinkali, Herbed Sulguni Fondue & Beetroot Carpaccio with Walnuts
pois.description: Innovative neo-Georgian bistro located directly facing the historic sulfur bath domes, headed by celebrity chef Tekuna Gachechiladze.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Contemporary Georgian gastronomy right in the historic sulfur bath district
✓ Creative vegetarian options including mushroom khinkali and herbed sulguni
pois.tip: Ideal for a relaxing lunch directly after visiting the Abanotubani sulfur baths or Legvtakhevi waterfall.
